decisions.reason: The availability-payment sizing targets use DSCR and equity IRR as outcomes but do not change the independently specified debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or financing structure.
Sizing the availability payment against DSCR and equity IRR does not change the capex estimate, site-capex basis, provisional status, or shared-cost treatment.
The availability-payment targets do not alter the operating-cost range or its source basis; the same message addresses Opex through a separate client decision already represented in this Requirement.
The DSCR and equity-IRR sizing decision does not change which site list is authoritative.

The existing narrative purpose of justifying availability payments for viability and bankability remains valid unchanged; the source adds quantitative sizing rules owned by the source Requirement rather than a new narrative requirement.
The source establishes availability-payment sizing values but does not change the requirement to annotate assumptions or use the supplied materials as reference points.
The quantitative sizing decision supplies model inputs but does not modify the independent requirements for data review, error checking, or modeling quality.
Adding DSCR and equity-IRR targets to availability-payment sizing does not change the model's presentation-quality requirement.
